title: Inflation Comes in Hotter Than Expected at 3.7%, Keeping Fed Hike Bets Alive (UPDATED)
summary: Consumer prices rose from 3.4% to 3.7% year-ove-year in September, above the 3.6% economists expected, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics report released Wednesday.
